title: Generate Route
description: Generate a new route page with optional table, form, and mock data

title.description: Page title displayed in the header

breadcrumb.description: Breadcrumb label. Defaults to title if not set.

table.description: Include a data table with URL-synced pagination/sorting/search
table.x-prompt: Does this page need a data table?

entityName.description: Entity name for table/form (PascalCase, e.g. LeaveRequest)

form.description: Include a form dialog for creating/editing
form.x-prompt: Does this page need a form dialog?

api.description: Generate API hooks (React Query) in data-access lib
